APPROVE

The extracted `MatchesRequested` keeps every original path: non-object entries are skipped, an empty or null requested version takes the first object entry, and otherwise only an exact string `num` match returns. Removing the nested ifs and `continue`s brings `Parse` well under 15, and the new helper uses only syntax and nullable annotations the file already has, so it should build cleanly. I reviewed the diff only and did not build it or run the tests.
